Description: "Always show department filter tabs (All, Dining, Pickup/Delivery, Preorder) at the top of the tables grid, regardless of the showTableDepartments setting. This makes the tabs the primary way to navigate between table types."
Instruction: "Remove posSettings.showTableDepartments gate from both combined and separate view layouts so the department filter tabs (All, Dining, Pickup, Delivery, Preorder) are always visible."
